description: This PHP source file defines an abstract base class 'IntegrationTestCase' for Twig integration tests, providing utility methods for loading test fixtures, configuring Twig environments, and executing test cases. It includes methods for handling test fixtures, dependencies injection, and executing complex rendering assertions, serving as a helper for test suites.
